passages.text: A Psalm of praise. Of David.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
David wrote this psalm.
This psalm gives praise to God.

passages.text: I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm of praise.
David speaks to God.
God is David’s God.
God is King.
David says, “I will exalt You.”
David says, “I will bless Your name.”
David will do this forever and ever.
passages.original: תְּהִלָּ֗ה לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ֣ אֱלוֹהַ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַאֲבָרֲכָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

passages.text: Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever and ever.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm as a song of praise.
David speaks to God, who is his King.
David says, “Every day I will bless You.”
David says, “I will praise Your name forever.”
David says, “I will praise Your name without end.”
passages.original: בְּכָל־ י֥וֹם אֲבָרֲכֶ֑ךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָ֥ה שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

passages.text: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is great.
The LORD deserves much praise.
No one can measure the LORD’s greatness.
No one can fully understand the LORD’s greatness.
passages.original: גָּ֘ד֤וֹל יְהוָ֣ה וּמְהֻלָּ֣ל מְאֹ֑ד וְ֝לִגְדֻלָּת֗וֹ אֵ֣ין חֵֽקֶר׃

passages.text: One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts— the glorious splendor of Your majesty. And I will meditate on Your wondrous works.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is great.
The LORD does mighty acts.
One generation will praise the LORD’s works to the next generation.
One generation will tell the next about the LORD’s mighty acts.
The LORD’s majesty is glorious and splendid.
I will meditate on the LORD’s wondrous works.
passages.original: דּ֣וֹר לְ֭דוֹר יְשַׁבַּ֣ח מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וּגְב֖וּרֹתֶ֣יךָ יַגִּֽידוּ׃ הֲ֭דַר כְּב֣וֹד הוֹדֶ֑ךָ וְדִבְרֵ֖י נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֣יךָ אָשִֽׂיחָה׃

passages.text: They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds, and I will declare Your greatness.
passages.sermon:
God performs awesome deeds.
These deeds show great power.
People will proclaim the power of God's awesome deeds.
I will declare God's greatness.

passages.text: They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of Your righteousness.
passages.sermon: God is abundantly good.\r\nPeople will speak about God's great goodness.\r\nPeople will praise God's righteousness with joyful songs.
passages.original: זֵ֣כֶר רַב־ טוּבְךָ֣ יַבִּ֑יעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ׃

passages.text: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is gracious.
The LORD is compassionate.
The LORD is slow to anger.
The LORD abounds in loving devotion.
passages.original: חַנּ֣וּן וְרַח֣וּם יְהוָ֑ה אֶ֥רֶךְ אַ֝פַּ֗יִם וּגְדָל־ חָֽסֶד׃

passages.text: The LORD is good to all; His compassion rests on all He has made.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is good to all.
He shows goodness to every person.
He created all things.
His compassion covers everything He has made.
He cares for all His creation.
No one is outside His kindness.
Nothing He made is without His mercy.
passages.original: טוֹב־ יְהוָ֥ה לַכֹּ֑ל וְ֝רַחֲמָ֗יו עַל־ כָּל־ מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃

passages.text: All You have made will give You thanks, O LORD, and Your saints will bless You.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is gracious and compassionate.
He is slow to anger.
He abounds in loving devotion.
He is good to all.
His compassion rests on all He has made.
All that the LORD has made will give Him thanks.
His saints will bless Him.
passages.original: יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וַ֝חֲסִידֶ֗יךָ יְבָרֲכֽוּכָה׃

passages.text: They will tell of the glory of Your kingdom and speak of Your might, to make known to men Your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of Your kingdom.
passages.sermon:
God rules over all creation.
God’s kingdom is glorious.
People will speak about the glory of God’s kingdom.
People will talk about God’s great power.
They will tell others about God’s mighty acts.
They will make known the splendor of God’s kingdom.
God’s kingdom is full of majesty and honor.
passages.original: כְּב֣וֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ֣ יֹאמֵ֑רוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ֥ יְדַבֵּֽרוּ׃ לְהוֹדִ֤יעַ׀ לִבְנֵ֣י הָ֭אָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָ֑יו וּ֝כְב֗וֹד הֲדַ֣ר מַלְכוּתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.
passages.sermon:
The LORD rules over all things.
His kingdom lasts forever.
His rule continues through every generation.
The LORD always keeps His promises.
He acts with kindness in everything He does.
passages.original: מַֽלְכוּתְךָ֗ מַלְכ֥וּת כָּל־ עֹֽלָמִ֑ים וּ֝מֶֽמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ֗ בְּכָל־ דּ֥וֹר וָדֽוֹר׃

passages.text: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.
passages.sermon:
The LORD helps every person who falls.
The LORD lifts up every person who is bowed down.
The LORD acts with kindness and faithfulness.
The LORD rules over all people in every generation.
The LORD’s kingdom lasts forever.
passages.original: סוֹמֵ֣ךְ יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־ הַנֹּפְלִ֑ים וְ֝זוֹקֵ֗ף לְכָל־ הַכְּפוּפִֽים׃

passages.text: The eyes of all look to You, and You give them their food in season.
passages.sermon:
God rules forever.
God cares for every living thing.
All living things look to God.
They wait for God to help them.
God gives food to every creature.
God gives food at the right time.
passages.original: עֵֽינֵי־ כֹ֭ל אֵלֶ֣יךָ יְשַׂבֵּ֑רוּ וְאַתָּ֤ה נֽוֹתֵן־ לָהֶ֖ם אֶת־ אָכְלָ֣ם בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: You open Your hand and satisfy the desire of every living thing.
passages.sermon: The LORD is the subject.\r\nThe LORD opens His hand.\r\nThe LORD satisfies the desire of every living thing.
passages.original: פּוֹתֵ֥חַ אֶת־ יָדֶ֑ךָ וּמַשְׂבִּ֖יעַ לְכָל־ חַ֣י רָצֽוֹן׃

passages.text: The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is righteous.
He is righteous in all His ways.
The LORD is kind.
He is kind in all His deeds.
passages.original: צַדִּ֣יק יְ֭הוָה בְּכָל־ דְּרָכָ֑יו וְ֝חָסִ֗יד בְּכָל־ מַעֲשָֽׂיו׃

passages.text: The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
passages.sermon: The LORD is near.\r\nHe is near to all who call on Him.\r\nHe is near to everyone who calls out to Him in truth.
passages.original: קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־ קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃

passages.text: He fulfills the desires of those who fear Him; He hears their cry and saves them.
passages.sermon: The LORD fulfills the desires of those who fear Him.\r\nThe LORD hears their cry.\r\nThe LORD saves them.
passages.original: רְצוֹן־ יְרֵאָ֥יו יַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְֽאֶת־ שַׁוְעָתָ֥ם יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵֽם׃

passages.text: The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
passages.sermon: The LORD preserves all who love Him.\r\nThe LORD destroys all the wicked.
passages.original: שׁוֹמֵ֣ר יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ כָּל־ אֹהֲבָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ הָרְשָׁעִ֣ים יַשְׁמִֽיד׃

passages.text: My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He is holy.
My mouth will speak His praise.
Every creature should bless His holy name.
We should bless His name forever.
We should bless His name for all time.
passages.original: תְּהִלַּ֥ת יְהוָ֗ה יְֽדַבֶּ֫ר־ פִּ֥י וִיבָרֵ֣ךְ כָּל־ בָּ֭שָׂר שֵׁ֥ם קָדְשׁ֗וֹ לְעוֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
